anti_generic_signature_read: The edge, and the loop. The edge is an unbroken skirt of leaning, unequal, sharp-tipped tongues whose lengths vary by more than a factor of two in an irregular sequence, with deep V troughs whose floors run straight into the next tongue's flank; because the tongues neither match the lane count nor repeat on a period the perimeter never resolves into a countable pattern. The loop is the only element that is not radial and not repeated: it reads as a solar prominence that has leapt off the limb, arched over and fallen back in.
blind_action_read: A person moves counters along the radial lanes, in and out from the centre. Every occupied lane holds one colour only, in a single evenly spaced file; the two colours never share a lane; the hub is a neutral blank destination that one counter occupies in the third signature frame. A two-player race or capture game with a shared centre.
blind_form_read: In plan a circle; in section a thin flat slab with a dead-straight unbroken top line. Plan silhouette is a continuous ragged sunburst: every part of the perimeter is either a pointed tongue's flank or the V trough between two tongues, never a plain arc. Tongues lean, are markedly unequal, better than two to one shortest to longest, and are broader at the root than they are long. A plain hub about 26 percent of the diameter sits proud at the centre; the skirt sits a step below the lane surfaces.
blind_held_read: A round, flat, sun- or flower-shaped disc board with loose sculpted counters resting on it. One solid circular plate with a plain raised centre, radiating wedge-shaped lanes in two alternating tones, a deeply serrated amber skirt running all the way round the edge, and about thirty small two-colour pieces lying in single-file rows on eight of the lanes.
blind_relationship_read: Concentric around one centre. The hub is the origin and all 24 lanes meet it; all lanes run outward to the same rim band; the skirt surrounds the whole. Counters sit on lane faces, one lane each, aligned to the lane centreline, none straddling a seam, none on a tongue or on the skirt. The amber hub, seams, skirt and loop are one continuous colour threading between every yellow and tan panel.
blind_subjects_read: 24 radial lane tiles, twelve lemon-yellow and twelve tan, strictly alternating; on the order of 38 to 42 rim tongues, not in step with the lanes; 16 cream teardrop counters and 15 dark brown bell-with-ears counters, read as 31 counters in two silhouettes; and one arched loop at the lower rim.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'roughly 10 or 11 per quadrant in top.png, so on the order of 38 to 42 in total, against 24 lanes'. The critic reached that by quadrant sampling, not by looking for a target. The plan audit measures 38.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Between 32 and 44 tongues around the rim.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'Every part of the perimeter is either the flank of a pointed tongue or the V-shaped trough between two tongues; I cannot find anywhere on the circumference that reverts to a plain circular arc', and 'in hero-detail.png the bottom edge is one unbroken zigzag across the full crop'. The plan audit measures the longest such arc at 1.198 degrees.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Every point on the perimeter belongs to a tongue flank or a trough; no arc of plain circular edge longer than 4 degrees anywhere.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'each one's root where it joins the body is wider than the tongue is long - a root of about 140 px against a length of about 110 px, and the short ones have roots of about 90 px against lengths of about 50 px. Adjacent roots run into each other at the trough floors; the troughs are sharp V-notches with no flat land between them.' Ratios 127 and 180 percent; the critic's own scale estimate put the narrowest root near 10 mm. The plan audit measures 8.409 mm and 116 percent, join gap 0.0 mm.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Each tongue's root where it meets the body is at least 60 percent of that tongue's own radial length, the thinnest root at least 6 mm, and adjacent roots meet.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'the shortest are stubs about 50 px ... while the longest reach about 110 px ... a range of better than two to one', and, recorded spontaneously as an aesthetic note, 'The sequence of long and short does not alternate, mirror or climb ... medium, long, medium, short, short, long, medium, long, short, which is irregular.' The plan audit measures 2.325 to 9.085 mm, ratio 3.908, with every circular shift and every mirror axis rejected in validation.py.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Lengths vary by at least a factor of two between the shortest and the longest tongue, and the sequence around the ring is not periodic, mirrored or sorted.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'the deepest troughs measure about 5% of the disc diameter from trough floor to the tip of the neighbouring tongue, the shallowest about 2.5%'. Five percent of 190 mm is 9.5 mm. The critic called this met at the boundary of what an image can resolve; the plan audit measures eight troughs at or over 9 mm with the deepest at 9.24 mm.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Apparent flame depth from the bottom of a trough to the tip of an adjacent tongue is at least 9 mm for the deeper troughs.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'the skirt reads as one continuous silhouette with the body; there is no separated crescent anywhere', and the critic's problem list contains no floating element, explicitly noting that the previous version's detached piece 'is gone entirely'. The plan audit measures one plan piece with one hole, and the hole is the hero loop.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Nothing floats: every tongue is solid material continuous with the disc, and no tongue shows daylight between itself and the body seen from directly above.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'one closed band of amber that springs out of the skirt, arcs outward and upward clear of the edge, and comes back down into the skirt a few tongues away ... it is anchored at both ends, it lifts out of the plane of the skirt, and the skirt's tongues are still visible running along behind and under its span ... so it adds to the edge rather than substituting for a piece of it.' Exactly one. The plan audit measures one closed loop of 81.513 mm2 with two tongues under it.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: One closed loop that leaves the edge and rejoins it, sitting inside the skirt and rising out of it, not replacing a stretch of it, with the skirt continuing underneath it.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'It does not read as gear teeth or as a clock face: gear teeth are equal and countable, and there are no twelve or sixty positions here, no indexed tips, no dots', and 'because the tongues neither match the lane count nor repeat on a period, the perimeter never resolves into a countable pattern'. 38 tongues against 24 lanes.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: The ring must never read as a regular gear or a clock face.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind, and volunteered before the brief was revealed: 'it reads as fire - a continuous licking corona, tongues of flame of unequal height leaning the same way round the disc', and of the arch, 'a solar prominence - a loop of flame that has leapt off the limb, arched over, and fallen back in'. Nothing in the skirt was logged as broken, detached or leftover.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: The rim must read as fire, not as damage.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'side-profile.png shows the whole object as a single horizontal band with a dead-straight, unbroken top line running the full width', and 'Nothing in the skirt rises above the board's flat top face.' The crown is extruded Z0 to Z8.0 against lane tops at Z8.8.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: No tongue may rise above the flat top of the board.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'none of them straddles a seam - each row sits inboard of both its lane's side boundaries. None sits on a tongue or on the skirt.' The fit audit measures zero contact between any counter footprint and any neighbouring tile or boundary marker.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: No counter may rest on a tongue, on a boundary marker, or across a lane boundary.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'I count 24, twelve lemon-yellow and twelve tan, strictly alternating', and 'All 24 lanes are present, none is truncated or blocked, and each looks long enough to hold at least the six counters that the longest occupied row carries.' The fit audit measures the full five stations by three layers on every lane.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: No lane may be missing and no lane may have reduced capacity.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'The hub is entirely blank ... no edge, no lip, no division, no marking'. The four short dashes the critic noticed near radius 65 are the preserved capsule bank markers carried over unchanged from the set being corrected, which are relief geometry and not print.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: The board must carry no endpoint dots and no printed marking.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: the critic named four distinct values without prompting - 'lemon-yellow lanes, a khaki/greige tan ... counters in near-white cream and dark chocolate brown' - and counted 31 counters across seven images without once mis-assigning a colour. The greyscale audit confirms the sealed light-to-dark ordering on the canonical top render.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: The two lane tones must stay separable from each other and from both counter colours.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: 'There is no randomiser of any kind visible: no dice, no spinner, no dial, no pointer, no card slot, no notched wheel, no numbered ring. Whatever decides a move is not part of this object.' The critic read the hero arch as a prominence or a handle, never as a pointer or dial.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Nothing may be added that reads as a printed substitute for the absent dice.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind: the critic read the object as a plain circle in plan with no axis standing out, consistent with a near-square envelope. The plan audit measures 190.999 by 192.362 mm.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: The outer envelope must not exceed 194 mm in either axis.

largest_risk: The crown is a flat extrusion, so it reads as fire in plan and in three quarter view but not edge-on: the critic, unprompted, saw side-profile.png collapse into 'a row of square-ended blocks with parallel slots ... more like a knurl or a castellation than like flame'. Flame is a plan-view property of this object and does not survive into the silhouette at eye level. Giving the tongues a vertical profile would change the board's sealed 8.0 mm deck and its printability, so the limitation is accepted and disclosed rather than repaired. Second, smaller: the hero crest is the furthest-out point on the whole object and the tongue tips are fine points 1.3 mm thick on a 9 mm slab, so both are what a knock would find first.
resolution: Two independent blind reads were run on two successive geometries and no earlier review is reused as evidence. The first read found two blocking defects: the hero read as 'leftover or unfinished geometry (a detached handle, bail, or sketch remnant)', and the rim read as a 'pinwheel/gear' of spurs with 'a tiny knob at its very tip, like a bud or a claw'. Both were repaired at source: the hero became a domed arch with steep rooted legs and a crest that is the highest point on the rim, its closed loop growing from 66.5 to 81.5 mm2; the tongue tip cap dropped from 1.30 to 0.80 mm so each tongue tapers to a point instead of a knob; and each tile now pulls back to radius 87.6 in the counter-free window at every lane boundary so the crown shows its own base as 24 open bays instead of meeting the tile edge. The second blind read reversed the verdict without prompting: 'it reads as fire - a continuous licking corona', the loop 'a solar prominence', and the critic recorded that the detached piece 'is gone entirely ... this was my single worst finding and it is fully resolved'. Its remaining observations are the preserved backgammon setup position, the preserved open capture bar, the four preserved capsule bank markers and the 1.1 mm gaps between tile tops; each was inspected against the sources and none is a defect in this correction. The print-gate map is empty and the product is sealed digitally-verified-not-print-ready: the wall and overhang gates passed on all 55 parts in the Make rounds, but the integrated verifier was not run in its print-gate tier, so no combined print-readiness verdict exists and none is claimed.
reviewer: independent native critic, images only; two unprimed blind reads, each recorded in full before the correction brief was revealed, one on the first geometry and one on the repaired geometry
